item.title: Multiple killed, injured in 3 separate Amarillo shootings over the weekend
item.description: The Amarillo Police Department released more information regarding the three weekend shooting incidents, none of which were connected. Officials said that due to the number of incidents in a short amount of time, the APD's emergency operation center was activated for assistance.

item.title: Amarillo, Wild West Wildlife Rehabilitation Center partner to relocate prairie dogs from John Stiff Memorial Park
item.description: The City of Amarillo announced Monday it will implement "a flexible plan" to address the population of prairie dogs at John Stiff Memorial Park, in what officials called a response to "community concerns."

item.description: AMARILLO, Texas (KAMR/KCIT) — Panhandle Great 25 Nurses is now accepting nominations for its annual nurse recognition program and has opened scholarship applications that support nursing education across the Texas Panhandle. item.description: On this episode of Four More Pages, Mya is joined by Weekend Anchor and Reporter Jack Kessler.

item.title: Vance visits Austin for fundraiser with $50,000 cover charge
item.description: Vice President J.D. Vance is traveling to Austin to attend a fundraising event hosted by Palantir co-founder Joe Lonsdale, where donors must pledge $50,000 or more, while Texas State Rep. Christina Morales criticizes Vance for focusing on wealthy tech billionaires instead of working families.

item.title: 2026 Remarkable Women: Kara Gaut
item.description: She turned compassion into a calling and built an organization that’s changing lives across the Panhandle. Kara Gaut, founder and CEO of Children’s Home Healthcare, is being recognized as a 2026 local Remarkable Women finalist for her dedication to caring for children and supporting families when they need it most.

item.title: Red Cross Giving Day encourages support for families affected by disasters
item.description: Red Cross Giving Day is Wednesday, and the American Red Cross North Texas Region is encouraging the community to come together to support families impacted by disasters and emergencies.

item.title: Amarillo folk-rock band Plemons Bridge to perform on KWTS' Live Lounge series
item.description: A folk-rock band from Amarillo will perform next in the West Texas A&M University concert series, showcasing their rising popularity in the local music scene.
